summary: This lecture from Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter) Part 101 focuses on the detailed account of the Isra and Miraj (Night Journey and Ascension) of Prophet Muhammad. Sheikh Ali Mashhour explains how this event was narrated by numerous companions across different times and contexts, leading to minor variations in details such as the order of events and which year it occurred, while maintaining agreement on the core event itself. The lecture covers the physical nature of the journey (with body and soul), the purification of the Prophet's heart by Jibreel, the description of Al-Burak (the miraculous animal), and the journey to Al-Masjid al-Aqsa. It continues with the ascension through the seven heavens, meeting Prophet Adam in the first heaven, and the spiritual significance of these encounters.
